name: Hume EVI 4-mini
access: Hume EVI API (wss://api.hume.ai/v0/evi), through a config with evi_version 4-mini

voice.input_audio: Linear 16 PCM (announce it with a session_settings message: format linear16, sample rate and channels, for example 44,100 Hz mono) or a container such as WebM; mu-law is not supported [hume-audio-guide] [hume-chat-ref]
voice.output_audio: Base64 WAV chunks at 48 kHz in audio_output messages [hume-chat-ref]
voice.voices: More than 100 predesigned voices in the Voice Library, plus custom voices that a user designs or clones; a voice must be set in the config (no default voice for EVI 3) [hume-voice] [hume-evi-version]
voice.turn_detection: turn_detection in the config: end_of_turn_silence_ms 500 to 3000 (default 800), speech_detection_threshold 0.0 to 1.0 (default 0.5), prefix_padding_ms 0 to 1000 (default 300) [hume-turn-detection]
voice.interruption: By default EVI stops generating and streaming as soon as it hears the user, and sends a user_interruption message; the client must stop playback and clear queued audio; interruption.min_interruption_ms 50 to 2000 (default 800) sets how long the user must speak before EVI yields [hume-interruptibility] [hume-interruption]
voice.session_limit: Max duration timeout default 1,800 seconds and at most 1,800 seconds (minimum 30); inactivity timeout default 120 seconds, 30 to 1,800 seconds [hume-timeouts]
voice.latency: Hume: about 100 ms faster on each response than EVI 3; no absolute figure [hume-evi-version]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Not per token. Hume's pricing page (read 2026-10-03) sells plans by month (Free US$0, Starter US$3, Creator US$7 for the first month then US$14, Pro US$70, Scale US$200, Business US$500, Enterprise on request) with included EVI minutes (5, 40, 200, 1,200, 5,000 and 12,500) and a per-minute figure beside each paid plan (US$0.07, 0.07, 0.06, 0.05 and 0.04). A separate line for additional EVI 3 use shows US$0.06, 0.05 and 0.04 per minute on the Pro, Scale and Business plans. The page text read does not say how these figures relate [hume-pricing]

voice.duplex: half is this library's reading; Hume describes interruptible turns with silence detection and does not call EVI full-duplex
